how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-ironforge-02-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:7342:title: Arrows Are For Sissies
rows.quest:7342:progress:0: Can you believe this rubbish?! The last shipment of ammunition from Kharanos was botched! All we have for ammo now are these flimsy, good for nothing arrows! What in the world am I going to do with 500,000 thorium headed arrows?⟦1⟧⟦2⟧I'll tell you what, kid. If you can bring me thorium shells, I'll trade you thorium headed arrows - straight up! Deal?
rows.quest:7342:completion:0: A done deal if I ever saw one! The arrows are yours.
rows.quest:3701:obj:0: Venture to the Ruins of Thaurissan in the ⟦E1⟧ and recover information from the Thaurissan Relics. Return to ⟦E2⟧ when you have recovered the information.

rows.quest:4513:obj:0: Bring 10 Filled Pure Sample Jars to ⟦E3⟧ in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:4513:obj:1: If you have trouble finding them, perhaps try to get more clues from Laris.
rows.quest:4513:details:0: I'm going to need more samples, ⟦4⟧. But--and I don't know how to put this--they have to be pure samples. I know, I know. "What does 'pure' mean, Laris?" I'm not sure. I do know that these are corrupt... just like ⟦E5⟧. Which is what makes my realization so important. The oozes seem to adapt... to take on the aspects of the area they're in. I'll need to find samples that haven't been polluted. But where? Where?!
rows.quest:4513:details:1: Bah! ⟦5⟧, take these containers just in case you find any on your own.
rows.quest:4513:progress:0: So many things to consider. But what does it mean? And how does it affect the lives of the people of ⟦E6⟧?
rows.quest:4513:completion:0: You've found it? ⟦6⟧, you are a treasure unto yourself. Your dedication and aid has been magnificent and I could not possibly thank you enough.
rows.quest:4513:completion:1: Please, take this for your troubles. I have some work to do, but I'm sure, if you come back at a later time, I'll have need of your services again.
rows.quest:4513:completion:2: Thank you. Thank you so much.
